description: A React functional component 'ChangeEmail' that manages the user interface and logic for changing a user's email address, including form handling, validation, API interactions, and modal controls.

methods.name: validateCurrentPassword
methods.description: Validates user inputted current password by calling application validation method and alerting if invalid.

methods.name: resetProgressState
methods.description: Resets the submit button to default state and enables continuation.

methods.name: processEmailChange
methods.description: Performs the email change process after backing up data, locking continue button, calling changeEmail API, and returning success status.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Handles dialog dismissal, preventing close if a process is ongoing.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Main submission handler that validates password, processes email change, and updates UI state accordingly.

methods.name: handleDialogClose
methods.description: Handles user attempts to close the dialog, alerting if ongoing process.
